specs.title: A wrong first response stays recorded while correct practice and returning to saved feedback preserve other work
An unfinished review persists across topics, overview, markers, activities and reload, and its answer survives another reload
The compact overview and topic picker retain first-answer statuses and put focus on the topic chooser
First feedback, practice feedback and the topic overview are readable across desktop, phone, Arabic larger text and display themes
